description: Read one review as it stands: its state (waiting / approved / changes / rejected), every answer so far, and its publishing state. Does not wait. Needs the Mnemosyne OS app RUNNING: on macOS its window may be closed (the app stays up and the host reads the file); on Windows and Linux closing the last window quits the app, so it must be open. Scope review:ask.
name: mnemosyne_review_get
